messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The reporting service may be released only on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC, and any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-02-25 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-25]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to the Ember team. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger; it reads from the event bus instead. [valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger. [valid 2025-04-08 to 2025-09-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-08]
- On 2025-11-07, Farah walked Marcus through the reporting service runbook. [valid 2025-11-07 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
- As of 2025-05-09, the reporting service must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands. [constraint; valid 2025-05-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-05-09]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service sits with Team Dune; Team Boreal no longer owns it. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Boreal as of the 2025-03-17 handover. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- As of 2026-05-04, Team Boreal still owns the catalog service. [valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- On 2026-03-10, Team Dune observed that after Tuesday's deploy, the reporting service's p99 latency doubled. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- The reports pipeline depends on the ledger for the nightly balance export. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-10]
- As of 2026-02-10, the reports pipeline lives with Team Cinder; the Ember team kept it until then. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-10-reporting]
- As of 2026-05-25, Marcus has the Team Atlas pager for this cycle, taking over from Priya. [decision; valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-23, Priya has the Team Atlas pager for this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [decision; valid 2026-04-23 to 2026-05-25; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-23]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-09, Marcus carries the Team Atlas pager for this cycle instead of Priya. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to 2026-04-23; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-09]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-03, Priya carries the Team Atlas pager for this cycle instead of Tomasz Nowak. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to 2026-03-09; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-03]
    earlier: As of 2025-05-09, Tomasz Nowak carries the Team Atlas pager for this cycle instead of Priya. [decision; valid 2025-05-09 to 2025-07-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-09]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-07, Priya carries the Team Atlas pager until the next rotation. [decision; valid 2025-04-07 to 2025-05-09; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-07]
    earlier: Tomasz Nowak takes the Atlas pager for the cycle starting 2025-02-19. [decision; valid 2025-02-19 to 2025-04-07; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-19]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
